summary: The planned-route card does not have a real empty-state branch. When route history or preview data is missing, the card keeps the populated composition, which leaves a washed-out light-mode map slab, duplicate waiting copy, and a route title that can imply recommendation certainty that is not actually present.

exactCurrentFailure.title: Missing empty-state branch makes the card read as broken instead of intentionally waiting for route history
exactCurrentFailure.detail: The JSX always renders the full route-card shell and only removes the SVG preview, so the top of the card becomes dead decorative space when no preview exists. At the same time, the empty fallback copies are duplicated across both metadata slots, and the title can fall back to the active block name or a generic route label. In light mode this is especially weak because the map stage is a pale vellum gradient with very little visual density, so the surface loses hierarchy and trust rather than presenting a deliberate empty state.

evidence.note: Both metadata helpers return the same waiting-copy fallback when routeRecommendation is missing.
The title falls back to activeBlock/default route naming instead of explicitly signaling that no route recommendation is available.
The card has no alternate empty-state markup; only the SVG preview is conditional.
The light-mode map stage is intentionally pale; without a preview path it becomes a blank vellum field rather than a meaningful focal area.
Aerodynamic Gallery light mode requires breathable hierarchy and clear helper-copy contrast on pale surfaces.

preserveList: Keep the coach-owned routeRecommendation contract as the truth source for route choice; do not push selection logic back into the frontend heatmap helper.
Keep the real preview-state rendering when routeRecommendation.preview exists, including the current path/start/finish geography treatment.
Keep the confidence-story semantics visible when data exists, especially the distinction between distance-match, near-match, and best-available states.
Keep the planned-route card inside the existing /schedule signed-in planning shell and current weekly-plan layout.
Keep light-mode support in the shared schedule-plan-* selector family with the existing :is(.theme-light, .theme-high-contrast-light) baseline plus the explicit high-contrast-light override block.
Keep the card tied to real recent run geography rather than replacing it with a fake permanent map illustration.

highestValueImplementationDirection.northStar: Give the card a true empty-state composition that still feels premium in light mode, while leaving the populated route-preview branch untouched.
direction: Branch the card explicitly for no-preview or no-route-history cases instead of reusing the populated preview shell with an absent SVG.
Replace the duplicated waiting metadata with one clear primary empty-state message and one quieter supporting line; do not let the title pretend a route recommendation already exists.
Turn the top visual stage into an intentional vellum placeholder with soft editorial depth, a subtle non-literal scaffold, and one focal cue, rather than a blank pale map slab.
Keep the populated route-preview version exactly data-first: real path, real confidence line, real anchored-run count.
Treat the CTA honestly in the empty branch so it does not oversell a route that is not yet available; its visual weight should support the explanation rather than compete with it.
lightModeGuidance: Use Aerodynamic Gallery layering: warm vellum separation, glass/fog overlay logic, and explicit contrast for helper copy.
Avoid divider-led containment and avoid dropping dark-mode route styling onto a pale surface.
Solve hierarchy with spacing, tonal separation, and one clear focal cue before adding more chrome.
dualModeSafety: Implement the empty branch as a schedule-plan-route modifier/state rather than a separate one-off card pattern.
Preserve structural parity across dark and light modes; only the tonal architecture and contrast behavior should differ.

risksOrBlockers.detail: A color-only tweak will not fix this bug. The failure is structural: the empty state needs its own hierarchy and copy path.
If implementation collapses the confidence/preview branch into a decorative placeholder or recomputes route choice in the frontend, it will break the preserve set.
No hard blocker found for the review lane.

notes: Review was anchored to design.md, the Schedule capsule in .ai-sync/CONTEXT_LEDGER.md, frontend/src/pages/Schedule.jsx, and the relevant schedule-plan-route-* CSS blocks only.
No application source files were edited in this lane.
